name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Swift1.5 (azampatti)

contents.model-swift15-attn.safetensors: ukisai/Swift1.5-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next attention projections (156 tensors: GDN in_proj_qkv/in_proj_z/out_proj, QSA q/k/v/o), block-quantised to fp8 e4m3 with 128x128 scales exactly like the base model's attention (312 tensors incl. weight_scale_inv)
contents.model-healed-shared-expert.safetensors: shared expert healed on the Swift1.5 trunk (V11: HEAL-B KL recipe, Swift-generated xhigh corpus, epoch 2 stopped at global step 2050): 48 layers x gate/up/down 1280-wide fp8 e4m3 + scales, plus the 48 trained shared_expert_gate rows in bf16 (336 tensors; same names/shapes as the base file it replaces)
contents.model.safetensors.index.json: the base model's index with the 312 attention keys pointed at model-swift15-attn.safetensors

unchanged_from_base: everything else: int4 AutoRound routed experts (top-k 5), int4 lm_head, fp8 PLE table, MTP speculative head, embeddings, norms, config.json (identical), chat templates
serving: eugr spark-vllm-docker, vllm-node-b12x image (same as the base model's b12x recipes); recipes in eugr/
